name: io.github.Servosity/netsapiens-mcp
title: NetSapiens MCP
description: Every NetSapiens v2 endpoint plus a reseller-wide fleet view: seat limits, offline phones, unrouted

environmentVariables.name: NETSAPIENS_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Set the NETSAPIENS_API_KEY credential for the NetSapiens MCP server.

environmentVariables.name: NETSAPIENS_SERVER
environmentVariables.description: Set the NETSAPIENS_SERVER credential for the NetSapiens MCP server.

environmentVariables.name: NETSAPIENS_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Overrides the whole base URL (https://<host>/ns-api/v2) when your provider uses a different path.

environmentVariables.name: PRINTING_PRESS_CLIENT_PROFILE
environmentVariables.description: Only for tenant-gated multi-client deployments: binds the MCP server to an existing client profile.

environmentVariables.name: NETSAPIENS_MCP_READ_ONLY
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Set to exactly 1 to expose only read-only tools and refuse any state-changing execute call.

environmentVariables.name: NETSAPIENS_NO_LOCAL_DATA
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Set to 1 to keep no local copy of API responses.

environmentVariables.name: NETSAPIENS_MCP_HTTP_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Required only for --transport http: callers must send a matching Authorization: Bearer header.

environmentVariables.name: NETSAPIENS_USER_AGENT
environmentVariables.description: Overrides the User-Agent sent on NetSapiens requests.

environmentVariables.name: NETSAPIENS_MCP_UPLOAD_ROOT
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Leave unset: no NetSapiens MCP tool in this release takes a file, so this setting has no effect.
